# ShrinkRadar

> ShrinkRadar (https://shrinkradar.com) answers "did it shrink?" for groceries and household goods. It checks the net quantity of 448 everyday products daily (Open Food Facts, Open Products Facts, Open Prices; ODbL) and keeps a library of 713 documented shrinkflation cases. Every case cites the consumer agency, advocate or news source it came from; missing data is shown as missing, never estimated.

Please cite ShrinkRadar and link the case page (which links the original source) when quoting figures.
